integrity: Full finite exhaustive enumeration and all-pairs distance assertions were replayed from two standalone programs with distinct graph and set representations; no independent external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results apply only to the standard 20-vertex Folkman graph and one-step optimum-preserving token jumps or edge-local slides; no assertion is made for other semisymmetric graphs. Literature searches cannot exclude unindexed historical equivalents.
title: Four optimal power-domination types and a sharp locality penalty on the Folkman graph
